Evidence: According to a Kaiser Family Foundation poll, around two-thirds of U.S. adults do not plan to get updated COVID-19 booster shots soon. Specifically, only a third of adults surveyed said they either received the updated shots or plan to get the booster as soon as possible. Additionally, 12% of adults stated they would definitely not get the shot, while 18% would wait and see. This indicates a significant portion of the population is unwilling to take the booster dose, aligning with the claim that 42% of the eligible population is currently unwilling to take it.
